test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

I started feeling tired as I had been working for a long time and so I decided to __call the day__.
solution: The correct answer is '2' i.e. call it a day .
